title: Shipping methods
description: Shipping rates by country, postcode, weight and amount

help.pickup: No shipping address needed. Without rules it is always offered and free
help.rules: The FIRST matching rule is used, in this order. Countries: ES,PT (empty = all). Postcodes: 07* (starts with), 08000-08999 (range), !35* (except); empty = all. Weight and amount: from included, to excluded. If none matches, this method is not offered
help.groups: Only for these customer groups. Empty = all
help.slug: Part of the URL. Empty = generated from the name

validation.rule_country: Rule countries are 2-letter codes separated by commas (ES,PT)
validation.slug: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only
